description: A stereo distortion that squares the signal with gain and then folds whatever is left outside ±5V back inside

params.text: Sets how much the signal is multiplied before folding, 0 to 10; above 1 the signal is driven into the ±5V walls and squares off, and it comes up at 1
Sets how much of the signal beyond ±5V is folded back rather than clipped off, 0 to 10; at 0 the signal is clipped rather than folded, and it comes up at 0

inputs.text: Shifts GAIN; the voltage is added to the knob and the total is held between 0 and 20, so CV can take the gain to twice the knob's own limit
Shifts FOLD; the voltage is added to the knob and the total is held between 0 and 10
One side of the stereo signal to be distorted; with a cable in only one of the two inputs, that signal is used for both sides

outputs.text: One side of the distorted signal; with a cable in only one of the two outputs, and both inputs patched, the two sides are summed into it

notes: Polyphony follows the signal inputs, whichever of the two carries more channels; the GAIN and FOLD CVs are read one voltage per channel.
Bypassing the module passes each input straight to the output on its own side, and the normalling between the sides stops working.
The wolf's eyes show the positive part of each side's output, the left eye for the left channel and the right eye for the right.

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 20V.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the R input.
inputs.3:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the L input.
